mapper.select: select point from tbl_member where member_seq = #{memberSeq}
mapper.update: update tbl_member set point = point + #{amount} where member_seq = #{memberSeq}
update tbl_member set point = point - #{amount} where member_seq = #{memberSeq} and point >= #{amount}
mapper.insert: insert into tbl_point_history (point_history_seq, member_seq, history_type, amount, balance, trade_seq) values (seq_point_history.nextval, #{memberSeq}, #{historyType}, #{amount}, #{balance}, #{tradeSeq})
mapper.select: select point_history_seq, member_seq, history_type, amount, balance, trade_seq, to_char(regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as regdate from tbl_point_history where member_seq = #{memberSeq} order by point_history_seq desc
